title: The kit's nav column takes max-content at phone width
body:
## Summary
At a narrow viewport /kit's two-column grid gives the section index its full max-content width and the specimens what is left.

## Description
app/(studio)/kit/kit.module.css:6 `.kit{grid-template-columns:max-content minmax(0,1fr)}` has no media query; the nav's widest item ("Panels · headings · empty" at --fs-ui plus --sp-4 padding and --sp-3 nav padding) is roughly 200-230px, so on a 390px phone the body column is ~160px wide and every wide specimen (Status table, UpstreamBreak, Contract frames at 157-803px) scrolls inside it. Fixed looks like: under the phone breakpoint the nav folds to a row above the body (or a disclosure) and the body takes the width.

## Flow
- open /kit at 390x844
- kit.module.css:6 grid resolves nav = max-content
- body column ~160px; specimens overflow horizontally

## Expected impact
Anyone opening the kit on a phone or a narrow split pane sees specimens at a sixth of their size. Could break: the contract frames' fixed --frame widths are data and must not reflow.

## Evaluation
Claim: user - the specimens get the width at phone size
Before: nav column = max-content at 390px (walked from the CSS; not captured)
After: unmeasured
Method: simulation - no dev server or capture in a round-agent; pipeline/cx-capture.mjs kit --width 390 is the instrument
Result: unmeasurable
Gate: none
evidence: app/(studio)/kit/kit.module.css:6 .kit{...grid-template-columns:max-content minmax(0,1fr)} ; no @media in the file besides prefers-reduced-motion
instrument: CX_BASE=http://localhost:3007 node pipeline/cx-capture.mjs kit out.png --width 390 on both arms; measure the body column's width (getBoundingClientRect of #kit-body) and count horizontally overflowing specimens

title: A source.json the page cannot read crashes /kit instead of drawing its ErrorLine
body:
## Summary
page.tsx draws a parse failure of tokens/source.json as a live ErrorLine but lets a read failure throw, so the whole kit is a 500.

## Description
app/(studio)/kit/page.tsx:44 `parseSource(readFileSync(join(process.cwd(), "packages/ui/tokens/source.json"), "utf8"))`: parseSource returns a Result and :52 renders `!source.ok` as `<ErrorLine message=... live />`, the page's own zero-input-is-not-green rule; readFileSync throws ENOENT/EACCES (a cwd other than the repo root, a moved file) before that door, and the route renders the error boundary with no specimen at all. Fixed: the read inside the same Result door, its sentence verbatim in the ErrorLine, every non-token section still drawn.

## Flow
- start the app from a cwd that is not the repo root, or rename source.json
- GET /kit
- readFileSync throws; the route errors; no specimen is drawn

## Expected impact
The kit stays a usable sheet with one red line when its token file is unreadable. Could break: nothing reads the thrown error today.

## Evaluation
Claim: resilience - an unreadable token source is one ErrorLine, not a dead route
Before: 1 of 2 source failure doors throws (read), 1 renders (parse) - walked
After: unmeasured
Method: simulation - the node render of KitPage needs every section's client islands mocked (useShell, keymap dispatch); M of setup
Result: unmeasurable
Gate: none
evidence:
app/(studio)/kit/page.tsx:44 readFileSync(...) unguarded
app/(studio)/kit/page.tsx:52 {!source.ok && <ErrorLine message={`tokens/source.json: ${source.error.message}`} live />}
instrument: vitest: renderToStaticMarkup(KitPage) with vi.mock('node:fs') making readFileSync throw and useShell mocked (as tests/next-server/audio-desk-islands.test.ts does); A throws, B returns markup holding the ErrorLine and the Signal section

title: Two Motion acts on /kit (lockIn, moved) are played by no component
body:
## Summary
The kit's Motion card plays four prototype acts; lockIn (ratified) and moved (re-routed) have no @gt/ui consumer, so the 'design system as shipped' shows two motions nothing ships.

## Description
app/(studio)/kit/Motion.tsx:12-17 ACTS and app/(studio)/kit/kit.module.css playLock/playMoved and their @keyframes; a walk of packages/ui/src/**/*.css finds no `@keyframes lockIn` or `@keyframes moved` and no `animation:lockIn|moved` (fadeUp ships in library/DetailPanel, shake in desk/Desk). tests/next-server/kit-sheet.test.ts case 3 now pins them in UNSHIPPED_ACTS, a list that can only shrink. The decision is the operator's: drop the two specimens, or give a ratify (style lock) and a re-route their motion in the components, after which the list empties.

## Flow
- open /kit#motion
- press lockIn or moved
- the act plays; no screen of the studio ever plays it

## Expected impact
The motion vocabulary on the kit matches the product's. Could break: nothing; the acts are kit-only.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - the Motion card shows only shipped motion
Before: 2 of 4 acts unshipped (walk of packages/ui/src CSS, pinned by kit-sheet case 3)
After: 0 of 4 either way the decision goes
Method: gate - the case goes red on any change to the set
Result: better
Gate: direction
